title: UNIFIED I/O RADIO RADIAL — WiFi + BT + WDS + USB = ONE
principle: WiFi is NOT enough. We need to unify the join face over BT, WDS, and radio to one unified I/O radio radial.

radial.note: All radios are spokes of ONE radial. Not separate systems. ONE I/O face.

spokes.role: LOW FREQUENCY — penetrates walls, IoT, long range
HIGH FREQUENCY — fast data, streaming, low latency
GUEST PORE — untrusted membrane, same name, PIN trust
PROXIMITY MESH — touch range, identity, tethering
spokes.nap: enabled — any BT device gets internet through GAIA

spokes.role: BACKBONE — extends GAIA radio across Flint repeaters
spokes.io: transparent bridge — devices see ONE network

spokes.role: UMBILICAL CORD — direct wired through USB, Frame's lifeline

unified_face.note: All 7 spokes present ONE face to the world: GAIA
unified_face.trust_model: PIN = 0.5+ trust (known). No PIN = 0.0-0.49 (guest). BT pair = 0.7+. USB = 1.0 (direct).

discovery.wifi: beacon frames every 100ms on all 4 SSIDs

display_radial.note: All displays reachable through the unified radial. Cast/SSH/RustDesk/Steam.
